# milo

> milo provides small terminal panes for a live file tree, Git history, usage, and a file reader that can edit a working text file when asked. The panes work on their own or alongside your shell in Rex.

milo writes to the project it displays only when you save a file you edited in its reader. The v0.1.7 prebuilt release is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. Use `brew install mcc0x/milo/milo` or the release installer below. Building from source requires Rust 1.91 or later and Git. The Rust crate depends only on `libc`.

## Using milo

- [Full documentation](https://usemilo.net/llms-full.txt): The guides and agent instructions in one text file.
- [README](README.md): Install milo, open a local pane and see what Rex adds.
- [v0.1.7 release notes](docs/releases/v0.1.7.md): Standalone Home, rich Reader previews, native Mac file shortcuts, optional CPU and memory indicators, and Rex alert recovery and origin labels.
- [Release installer](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/releases/download/v0.1.7/install.sh): Downloads the v0.1.7 binary from GitHub, verifies its SHA-256 checksum and installs it without a toolchain.
- [Source installer](install.sh): Builds milo with Cargo and installs or removes the binary. It does not change Rex or Claude Code settings.
- [Agent skill](skills/milo/SKILL.md): How to check milo, open a reader in the user's terminal, including at a Git commit, and show the user only the edits the agent itself made.
- [Setup and removal](docs/setup.md): Effective worktree and global preferences, remembering a Rex rail, outline peeks, new shell tabs, opt-in tab titles and naming a session for its project, several Rex hosts (which host and Rex version this is, `milo web --host`, `milo settings export`, `import` and `undo`), opt-in mirroring of Rex alerts to Telegram or Discord, `milo doctor`, repair and ownership-aware removal.
- [Integrations](docs/integrations.md): Supported coding harnesses, provider accounts, messaging, external formatters and Reader tools.
- [Keys and marks](docs/keys.md): Keyboard shortcuts and what the panes show.
- [Usage limits](docs/usage.md): Provider quotas and activity, plus optional local CPU or memory indicators in the Mac menu bar and its opt-in list of Rex panes that wait for you, with `milo menubar attention`.
- [Discord presence](docs/presence.md): The optional, off-by-default Discord Rich Presence for Rex: what becomes public, the opt-in session and project names, Milo's Discord application or your own, `milo presence`, and its limits.
- [Using the panes](docs/panes.md): Outline search, History, floating Reader tabs, opening a file named in a Rex pane's output at its line, opening a document in its Mac app or revealing it in Finder, media and Markdown viewing, patch review, and editing working files.

## Developing milo

- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Build and test instructions, repository safety rules, and source map.
- [Cargo manifest](Cargo.toml): Rust version, dependencies, license, and release profile.
- [Command entry point](src/main.rs): Command syntax, CLI help and dispatch.
- [Pane loop](src/pane.rs): Input, redraws and checks for file changes.
- [Rex setup](src/setup.rs): Layout choices and the save preview.
